A re-run of Seed-IDE cannot fix this: the origin entry is ended, so the same refusal returns. The commit the stop names, fc263a7c7e (batten: Seed-IDE -> running), is present on origin: ls-remote origin refs/heads/main-weft returns 1676a1f72d, and fc263a7 is an ancestor of that tip by merge-base --is-ancestor. The run has also moved on past Seed-IDE: origin holds the Land commit 1676a1f72d, and local main-weft carries the Worktree-Teardown commit dc83e7eeab, ahead of origin by one. So the stop is stale rather than a missing push. Whether the run closes out through its teardown, and whether the stale Seed-IDE stop is cleared, is a decision for the run's parent, not a plain re-launch.
